verdict.rationale: Basecamp's pricing page documents reusable project and to-do list templates that carry the same structure, workflows, and setup across projects. That supports starting new projects from a template, but the evidence describes templates users create themselves, not a library of ready-made templates from Basecamp. missing for 10: evidence of vendor-provided pre-built templates, in-depth docs on creating a project from a template, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Create reusable project and to-do list templates with the same structure, workflows, and setup across projects.
